_note: System and error copy used by System Status, Connection recovery, Error architecture, Region states, Session, Permission, Route and Unexpected error. Wording is a placeholder. Messages never contain tokens, stack traces, raw exceptions or sensitive paths.

errorTypes.visual: Tinted strip with icon, title and one line

errorTypes.keyboard: role status. Dismiss button has a label

errorTypes.visual: Slim full-width bar under the top bar
errorTypes.placement: Under the top bar, above every page
errorTypes.dismiss: Not dismissible while the condition lasts
errorTypes.keyboard: role alert for a new global error, then role status

errorTypes.visual: Session expired layer with a single primary action
errorTypes.dismiss: None. The only exit is signing in
errorTypes.keyboard: role alertdialog. Focus on the primary action. Focus trap

errorTypes.visual: Region message with a lock-with-key icon and PERMISSION REQUIRED badge
errorTypes.placement: In place of the restricted region
errorTypes.retry: None. Action only if a real request flow exists
errorTypes.keyboard: Message is plain text. Action button only when real

errorTypes.visual: Local state chip in the component header and the status dock
errorTypes.severity: WARNING while reconnecting, ERROR after retries fail
errorTypes.placement: On the affected component and in the dock
errorTypes.retry: Automatic first, then manual Retry now
errorTypes.dismiss: None. Success shows a RESTORED toast
errorTypes.motion: Chip color --m-base 200 ms. Pulse only while RECONNECTING
errorTypes.keyboard: Chip text carries the state. No modal, no focus change

errorTypes.visual: Full page fallback: Something went wrong
errorTypes.placement: Replaces the page or, if the shell fails, the window
errorTypes.retry: Retry only when it is safe
errorTypes.dismiss: None. User returns or opens Diagnostics
errorTypes.keyboard: Focus on the heading. Retry, Diagnostics, Return are reachable with Tab

loading.slowText: This is taking longer than expected.
loading.rule: A loading state is never infinite. After the slow threshold the region offers Retry and keeps waiting. After the timeout it becomes ERROR.

stale.rule: A stale value keeps its last number, is dimmed, carries STALE and LAST UPDATE, and never looks live (no live dot, no pulse, no update animation).

partial.title: Some values are unavailable
partial.text: {what} could not be read. The rest is current.
partial.rule: Show what loaded. Name what did not. Retry targets the failed part only.

session.title: Your session expired
session.text: For your security you were signed out. Sign in again to continue where you were.
session.draft: You have unsaved changes on this page. They are not saved automatically and will be lost.

permission.title: You do not have access to this area
permission.text: Your account role does not include {area}. Access comes from your account's permissions, not from this screen.

patterns.meaning: The signed-in account lacks the role.
patterns.opens: A permission change by an administrator

patterns.meaning: A rule closes this on purpose.
patterns.opens: The stated condition, for example finishing TRAIN

patterns.meaning: The source is not there right now.
Nothing has been set up yet.

route.title: Page unavailable
route.text: This page does not exist or is no longer available.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.text: The app hit an unexpected problem. Your data was not changed.
unexpected.retryBlocked: Retry is turned off because repeating this action might not be safe.
unexpected.never: Technical details such as stack traces, tokens or file paths are never shown here.

startup.rule: No startup screen is shown when startup finishes within 800 ms. After that the minimal startup screen appears and stays until the route is ready.

launch.flow: Welcome → Sign in → Onboarding → Primary workspace
Sign in → Last valid route or primary workspace
Startup → Last valid route or primary workspace
Session expired → Sign in → Return to the last valid route
